landing_how_step_1_desc: Lozani kamera yanu ku tsamba lililonse lachikasu, zipatso zokhala ndi madontho, kuvunda kwa tsinde, kapena tizilombo toyambitsa matenda m'munda mwanu.
landing_how_step_2_desc: Kuwunika kukuwonetsa zifukwa zomwe zingatheke; si matenda otsimikizika.
landing_how_step_3_desc: Tsimikizani chifukwa chake ndi njira zovomerezeka zakomweko ndi woyang'anira zaulimi musanayambe chithandizo.
landing_faq_1_question: Kodi pulogalamuyi imagwira ntchito popanda intaneti m'minda yakumidzi?
landing_faq_1_answer: Njira zina zogwirira ntchito m'munda zimathandizira kugwiritsidwa ntchito popanda intaneti ndikugwirizanitsa zinthu intaneti ikabweranso. Kuwunika kwa Cloud ndi deta yakunja kumafuna intaneti; kupezeka kwake kumatengera chipangizo ndi momwe zinthu zakonzeredwa.
landing_faq_2_question: Kodi ndikufunika foni yamtengo wapatali kuti ndigwiritse ntchito GPExts?
landing_faq_2_answer: Pulogalamu ya pa intaneti imathandizira asakatuli a pafoni. Kupezeka kwa SMS ndi USSD kumatengera wopereka chithandizo ndi kasinthidwe ka kampani; funsani bungwe lanu kuti mudziwe njira zomwe zikugwira ntchito.
landing_faq_3_question: Kodi GPExts ndi yaulere kwa alimi ang'onoang'ono?
landing_faq_3_answer: Kupezeka ndi mtengo wake zimatengera bungwe lanu ndi momwe zinthu zakonzeredwa. Onani zambiri za ndondomeko yanu musanalembetse.
landing_faq_4_question: Ndi mbewu ziti ndi matenda ati omwe amathandizidwa pakali pano?
landing_faq_4_answer: Zolemba za matenda zikuphatikizapo mbewu zambiri ndi mikhalidwe, koma kupezeka ndi kulondola kwake kumasiyana. Zotsatira zake ndi malingaliro chabe, osati matenda otsimikizika; funsani katswiri wakomweko.
landing_faq_5_question: Kodi ndingamvetsere malangizo m'chilankhulo changa chakomweko?
landing_faq_5_answer: Thandizo la chilankhulo ndi mawu limasiyana malinga ndi mawonekedwe, msakatuli, ndi wopereka chithandizo. Onani chilankhulo chomwe chilipo ndi zosankha za mawu m'dongosolo lanu.
landing_faq_6_question: Kodi Oyang'anira Zaulimi ndi Mautumiki amagwiritsa ntchito bwanji GPExts?
landing_faq_6_answer: Oyang'anira zaulimi amagwiritsa ntchito GPExts pa njinga zamoto ndi maulendo a m'minda kuti alembetse alimi, kujambula malire a minda, kulemba mbiri ya zomwe aona, ndi kugwirizanitsa ntchito zopewera matenda. Unduna ndi mabungwe amagwiritsa ntchito tsamba la intaneti kuti aone mamapu a madera omwe ali ndi matenda ndi zolemba za m'minda.
